business_problem: The utility company faced operational inefficiencies due to the time-consuming manual referencing of extensive regulatory documentation.
solution_summary: Hawaiian Electric Company (HECO) seeks to create a green Hawaii, providing communities with reliable and renewable energy. The utility company faced operational inefficiencies due to the time-consuming manual referencing of extensive regulatory documentation. HECO leveraged the Databricks Data + AI Platform to develop a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) model proof of concept (POC), streamlining question-answering by integrating relevant data into the generation process. This allowed the regulatory team to quickly and accurately cross-reference documentation and provide answers to information requests about regulatory requirements and how HECO is staying compliant.
